controles.affirmation: fondamental_interne #3 : "Les filiales Repcon et EMCOR Industrial Services sont nommees dans plusieurs poursuites consolidees en multi-district litigation apres un accident a la raffinerie de Deer Park (Texas) ayant fait deux morts et environ 200 blesses ; le groupe indique croire que l'assurance couvrira la plupart ou la totalite des montants dus"
controles.verbatim_source: "On October 10, 2024, a chemical release occurred at the PEMEX Deer Park Refinery in Deer Park, Texas. As a result of the release, two people were killed and approximately 200 others claim to have suffered bodily injuries... Those lawsuits were thereafter assigned the status of “multi-district litigation” and consolidated in the 281st District Court, Harris County. Repcon, Inc. (“Repcon”) and EMCOR Industrial Services, Inc. (“EIS”), indirect subsidiaries of the Company, have been named in several of the lawsuits... Based on currently available information, we believe insurance will cover much or all of any amounts required to be paid by Repcon or EIS in connection with these claims."

controles.affirmation: hook + fondamental_externe #1 + quantitatif #1 : "les revenus lies aux data centers ont atteint 1 772,3 M$ au T2 2026 (+67,3%), soit 34,4% du chiffre d'affaires" ; "environ 713 M$ de la hausse de 850,5 M$ proviennent des seuls revenus data centers"
controles.verbatim_source: EMCOR ne publie aucune ligne "data center revenues". Les 1 772,3 M$ sont la somme du secteur "Network and communications market sector" des deux segments de construction : electrique 973,046 + mecanique 799,293 (T2 2026) contre 669,966 + 389,676 (T2 2025). Le 10-Q dit seulement : "the largest increase was seen within the network and communications market sector, PREDOMINANTLY DRIVEN BY greater demand for data center construction projects".
controles.correction_proposee: L'arithmetique est exacte mais le libelle assimile a tort la totalite du secteur "reseaux et communications" aux seuls data centers. Reecrire : "le secteur reseaux et communications, dont la croissance est principalement portee par les projets de data centers, atteint 1 772,3 M$ (+67,3%) et represente 34,4% du CA trimestriel", et remplacer "les seuls projets de data centers" par "ce seul secteur".
